arxiv-2403-05914.title: Migration and separation of polymers in non-uniform active baths
arxiv-2403-05914.creator: Pietro Luigi Muzzeddu, Andrea Gambassi, Jens-Uwe Sommer, Abhinav Sharma
arxiv-2403-05914.description: Abstract Polymer-like structures are ubiquitous in nature and synthetic materials. Their configurational and migration properties are often affected by crowded environments leading to non-thermal fluctuations. Here, we study an ideal Rouse chain in contact with a non-homogeneous active bath, characterized by the presence of active self-propelled agents which exert time-correlated forces on the chain.

arxiv-2409-07688.title: Charged Higgs Boson Phenomenology in the Dark 𝒁 Z mediated Fermionic Dark Matter Model
arxiv-2409-07688.creator: Kyu Jung Bae, Jinn-Ouk Gong, Dong-Won Jung, Kang Young Lee, Chaehyun Yu, Chan Beom Park
arxiv-2409-07688.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Kyu Jung Bae, Jinn-Ouk Gong, Dong-Won Jung, Kang Young Lee, Chaehyun Yu, Chan Beom Park. We present the phenomenology of the charged Higgs boson H ± H^{\pm} appearing in a fermionic dark matter model mediated by an additional scalar doublet. In order to couple the dark matter fermion to the scalar doublet, we introduce a U(1) X gauge symmetry, which is spontaneously broken at electroweak symmetry breaking, resulting in a massive Z ′ Z^{\prime} gauge boson.

arxiv-2412-11553.description: Abstract Accurate recognition and interpretation of sign language are crucial for enhancing communication accessibility for deaf and hard of hearing individuals. However, current approaches of Isolated Sign Language Recognition (ISLR) often face challenges such as low data quality and variability in gesturing speed.

pmc-12658937.description: The performance of electrocatalysts in fuel cells is not only determined by their efficiency under reaction conditions but also by their stability and potential degradation processes. pmc-13098646.title: Matrin-3 forms spherical and wormlike assemblies that are modulated by RNA binding and ALS/FTD-associated mutations
pmc-13098646.creator: Macy L Sprunger, Min Kyung Shinn, Sabrina K Talir, Ken Lee, Rohit V Pappu, Meredith E Jackrel
pmc-13098646.description: SUMMARYMatrin-3 (MATR3) is an RNA-binding protein (RBP) that is associated with familial amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and frontotemporal dementia (FTD). MATR3 features two RNA recognition motifs, two zinc-finger motifs, and four intrinsically disordered regions. Here, we report that human MATR3 associates with itself to form nanoscale spherical assemblies at ultralow protein concentrations.
